verdict_text: NO. The script sets `DROP_HEAD = 6` (and its docstring says "remove attention head 6"), but the specification's "Required result" clause says to remove head 5, keeping columns/rows `0..319`, `384..767`, ... — i.e. dropping the block `320..383` within each 768-wide segment. The artifact instead drops `384..447`, so every `h.<i>.attn.c_attn.weight`, `h.<i>.attn.c_attn.bias` and `h.<i>.attn.c_proj.weight` holds the wrong values, violating result clauses 1–3. The shape assertions still pass because the sizes are identical, so the error is silent, but grading is bit-exact and will fail.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
